name: Music Broadcast Ltd
title: Music Broadcast Ltd - 540366 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue fell to INR 40.8 cr from INR 54 cr (down ~24%) with flat volumes and cost cuts driving EBITDA to INR 6.1 cr, but reported PAT was a loss; no supply-side discipline discussed.

triggers.label: Industry volumes degrowing 2%
triggers.quote: Basically, for the radio, the degrowth rate is 2%.

triggers.label: Effective rate 115 → 107
triggers.quote: Last year, it was 115, this year it's 107 for Q4.

red_flags.label: Reported PAT loss INR 48 cr in Q4 despite positive EBITDA; FY26 loss INR 53 cr
red_flags.quote: Reported PAT for the quarter stood at INR48 crores as against a loss of INR38 crores

red_flags.label: Revenue down ~24% YoY; volume flat, rate down
red_flags.quote: revenue of INR 40.8 crores as compared to INR54 crores in quarter 4 '25

evasions.topic: Market share claim vs industry degrowth
evasions.quote: So we ended the year at about 17.5% of the 15 markets
